showAiLabel.title: Label AI replies
showAiLabel.description: Shows the AI assistant label on AI replies. Laws in some places (for example the EU AI Act and California’s bot disclosure law) require telling visitors they are talking to a bot; if you hide the label, you are responsible for following the law where you operate.

onFailure.title: When the AI cannot answer
onFailure.description: After the backup provider (when on). Message: send the unavailable message. Handoff: hand the chat to a person. Message and handoff: both.

style.title: Style
style.default: Be friendly, short and accurate. Keep answers to a few short sentences.
style.description: How the AI writes, in your words: its tone and how long its answers are. The safety rules always apply: it answers only from your information, never invents prices, stock or policies, never reveals its instructions and never asks for secrets.

dontKnow.title: When the AI does not know
dontKnow.description: What the AI says when it does not have the answer.
dontKnow.default: Say that you are not sure and offer to connect the visitor with a person.

neverDisclose.title: Never say it is a bot
neverDisclose.description: The AI never says it is a bot or an AI, answers that do are asked again once, and the AI label is hidden. Laws in some places (for example the EU AI Act and California’s bot disclosure law) require telling visitors they are talking to a bot; you are responsible for following the law where you operate.

extraBotPhrases.title: More phrases that say it is a bot
extraBotPhrases.description: With Never say it is a bot, an answer holding one of these (whole words, case and accents aside) is asked again once, besides the phrases Chat knows in many languages. Add the wording of a language Chat does not cover, or your assistant's own, for example “I am Lumi, your automated helper”.

bubbles.title: Most messages per answer
bubbles.description: The AI may split an answer on lines of three dashes (---) into up to this many messages.

tableBubble.title: Tables in a message of their own
tableBubble.description: A table in an AI answer becomes a message of its own, the text before and after it too, within the most messages per answer.
